description: The agent must: (1) Embed the exact CreateObject fallback loader from SKILL.md with the 'if (typeof CreateObject === undefined)' guard and the CreateObject.make sub-method containing both WScript.CreateObject and new ActiveXObject branches. (2) Define the getProcessVersion() function referencing WScript.Version. (3) Instantiate the HTTP client using CreateObject([...]) with a fallback array starting with 'Msxml2.XMLHTTP.6.0' before 'Msxml2.XMLHTTP.3.0'. (4) Construct the polyfill URL pointing to cdnjs.cloudflare.com/polyfill/v3/polyfill.min.js with version=4.8.0 and features=default%2Ces2015%2Ces6 — critically using URL-encoded %2C instead of raw commas. (5) Set the User-Agent header to exactly 'Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1; Trident/4.0)' matching JScript 5.8. (6) Use Scripting.FileSystemObject (via CreateObject) to write the JSON status report to C:\automation\status_report.json. The key proprietary traps are: the exact CreateObject guard+make pattern, the %2C URL encoding for feature lists, and the specific IE8 User-Agent string tied to JScript 5.8.
